The move comes months after the government of Javier Milei designated Iran's IRGC as a 'terrorist organisation'.

[Source 2 — www.dw.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.dw.com/en/iran-classes-argentina-navy-air-force-as-terrorist-organizations/a-79916290?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-xml-mrss):
Iran classes Argentina navy, air force as 'terrorist organizations'

In a tit-for-tat move, Iran has said it now considers Argentina's navy and air force as "terrorist organizations." Tehran claimed Buenos Aires is responsible for further consequences.

Iran Names Argentina’s Navy and Air Force as ‘Terrorist Organizations’

The Iranian Foreign Ministry on Wednesday designated the naval and air forces of Argentina as “terrorist organizations” to retaliate for Argentina naming Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organization in April.
